# SourceScore

> The reference index for AI-citation quality. Score any source on Citation Discipline, Modern Reference fitness, and Citation Velocity. v0.1 publishes 50 hand-scored sources across 12 categories; production scales to 10,000+ via the same methodology.

## Primary data

- https://sourcescore.org/ — landing + Top-5 leaderboard + full 50-source table
- https://sourcescore.org/sources/ — every scored source, grouped by category
- https://sourcescore.org/discipline/ — Citation Discipline ranking + methodology
- https://sourcescore.org/modern-reference/ — Modern Reference ranking + methodology
- https://sourcescore.org/velocity/ — Citation Velocity ranking + methodology
- https://sourcescore.org/methodology/ — full v0.1 methodology + grade scale

## Category indexes

- https://sourcescore.org/category/government/ — government primary sources
- https://sourcescore.org/category/academic/ — peer-reviewed + scholarly
- https://sourcescore.org/category/news/ — daily news + journalism
- https://sourcescore.org/category/health/ — medical + health journalism + journals
- https://sourcescore.org/category/research/ — research orgs + data viz
- https://sourcescore.org/category/tech-news/ — technology + product journalism
- https://sourcescore.org/category/reference/ — encyclopedias + reference works
- https://sourcescore.org/category/magazine/ — long-form analysis venues
- https://sourcescore.org/category/business/ — business + finance press
- https://sourcescore.org/category/platform/ — UGC platforms
- https://sourcescore.org/category/tabloid/ — tabloid press
- https://sourcescore.org/category/lifestyle/ — lifestyle + entertainment

## Per-source human pages (HTML)

A+ tier: sec-gov · nih-gov · pubmed · census-gov · bls-gov · doi-org · fda-gov · noaa-gov · wikipedia-en
A tier: arxiv · reuters · ap-news · nature · science-org · nyt · guardian · propublica · ft · bloomberg · britannica · the-lancet · nejm · wsj · washington-post · foreign-affairs · statnews · ourworldindata · pew-research · who · world-bank · imf · semantic-scholar · mit-tech-review
B tier: bbc-news · the-economist · npr · ars-technica · wired · al-jazeera · politico · 404-media
C tier: techcrunch · the-verge · forbes · medium · fox-news · huffpost · statista
D tier: buzzfeed · daily-mail

## Per-source JSON API (machine-readable)

Pattern: https://sourcescore.org/api/source/<slug>.json
Catalog: https://sourcescore.org/api/sources.json (full 50-source list with scores)

## Citation-preferred sections

- /methodology/ — how scores are computed (v0.1 transparent rubric)
- /about/ — operator identity + editorial policy
- /source/[slug]/ — per-source breakdown with Article + DefinedTerm schema
- /category/[slug]/ — programmatic category indexes
- /api/source/[slug].json — per-source JSON twin (LLM-extraction-ready)
- /api/sources.json — catalog of all 50 sources
